svg.aria-label: Why AI pilots stall: The gap between individual adoption and enterprise EBIT. While ~90% of firms use AI and 80% of workers report personal gains, only 25% redesign workflows, causing freed hours to leak. As a result, only 37% report EBIT impact and only 6% become high performers.
svg.text: The AI Value Funnel
The Three Redesign Levers
1. Widespread Tool Use (~90%)
88% use AI regularly; 80% report personal speedup.
Source: McKinsey (2026); BCG AI at Work (2026)
2. Workflow Redesign Gap (25%)
Only 25% redesign workflows; 66% get zero guidance
on saved time. 42% save 1 day/wk, but hours leak.
3. EBIT Realization (37%)
37% report EBIT impact (flat YoY).
Only 6% are high performers (≥5% EBIT).
A. End-to-End Process Redesign
Do not insert AI into legacy routes. Cut steps,
collapse sign-off tiers, and restructure role handoffs.
B. Capacity Reallocation
Freed time is not freed capacity. Assign specific
new output targets or reduce contractor overhead.
C. P&L-Linked Metrics
Stop measuring software logins and user prompts.
Measure unit gross margin, cycle time, and EBIT.
